headline: The Atlantic reports that a short story that won the Caine Prize for African Writing seems to be the work of AI.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered to 4: headline only, the Atlantic's page was blocked and no other reputable outlet carries the claim, so it is unverified.
importance_line: The question is whether a major literary prize went to machine-written work, which touches writers and prize judges first, then publishers and prize bodies, but The Atlantic says only that the story 'seems' to be AI-made, so the claim is unproven.
summary: The Atlantic reports that a short story that won the Caine Prize for African Writing seems to be the work of AI, the latest literary prizewinner to be questioned this way.
